description: Hi I am Alice! I am 14 years old and I live in Poland, Rybnik. I really like drawing and I am interested in figure skating a lot. I like learning languages. I can speak in Polish, English and I am learning German, Spainish and Portugues. This is the first time I'm taking part in this competition and doing everything myself. summary: This project is an illustrated children's book about space machines on Mars, the moon and in space. The whole book was made and designed by me. Each drawing was drawn by hand based on the pictures of the machines. Written in child-friendly language to make learning about rovers more enjoyable. This book shows that learning about space and space machines can be inspiring and interesting fun.
